notes: No ordering or atomic deployment constraint is required. The new customer version calls ledger.balance and prefers balanceCents, but falls back to the legacy decimal balance response, so it is compatible with old and new ledger instances. The ledger change must retain the legacy balance field while old customer instances remain in service; balanceCents should be additive. Existing statement events and the customer read model remain unchanged, so rollback to the old customer version is safe.
